classes.name: operating_statement
classes.hint: a commercial property's periodic (typically annual) statement of rental income and operating expenses, used to compute net operating income (NOI).

classes.name: appraisal
classes.hint: a third-party professional appraisal report valuing a commercial property, typically including the appraiser's own stabilized NOI projection supporting their valuation conclusion.

classes.name: rent_roll
classes.hint: a schedule listing a commercial property's individual leased suites/units, each with its tenant, square footage, current rent, and lease expiration date - distinct from 'operating_statement', which reports property-wide income/expense totals rather than a per-suite breakdown.

classes.name: lease
classes.hint: one tenant's own full lease contract (or a summary of it), covering their rent and the terms governing how much of the property's common-area-maintenance (CAM)/operating expenses they're obligated to reimburse - distinct from 'rent_roll', which lists every suite's current rent at a glance but not each lease's own reimbursement terms.

classes.name: lease_amendment
classes.hint: a short document restating only specific changed terms of a tenant's existing lease (e.g. 'First Amendment to Lease', 'Amendment to Lease Agreement'), referencing the original lease by date and parties rather than restating the whole contract - distinct from 'lease' (a full contract) by its own much shorter length and its explicit reference to amending a prior, already-executed lease.

classes.name: other
classes.hint: any document that is not one of the categories above. Use it when the document does not fit any of the other categories' descriptions, rather than choosing the closest category; but do not use it for a document that does fit one of them.
